Calls

# Phone and virtual meetings, then a transcript you can search.
Record calls on the card or earbuds. Notes land in the TicNote app.

Open-ear earbuds that record and transcribe on the go are listed as TicNote Pods WiFi. Open-ear 4G earbuds that record and transcribe without Wi-Fi are listed as TicNote Pods 4G (North America).
See Pods WiFi and Pods 4G.Buy Pods WiFi
